claims.claim: Intersect requests 1,193,000 ADA, described as $298,250, to fund Technical Steering Committee support activities for 12 months.
The proposal budget allocates 256,000 ADA to WP1, 832,000 ADA to WP2, and 105,000 ADA to WP3, totaling 1,193,000 ADA.
WP2 funds the Parameter Committee, CIP editors, and Hard Fork Working Group to support protocol governance and evolution.
WP3 will establish a pilot independent technical review programme launching in 2027 with conflict-of-interest provisions, published recusals, and open reviewer selection against documented criteria.
The proposal states that all expenditure will be fully accounted for and any unspent funds returned to the Cardano treasury.
Execution of the work packages is contingent on approval of the IntersectMBO budget proposal.
The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and provides references to voting and audit documentation.
The proposer states the requested amount does not breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit at submission and links to the relevant governance action.
Independent audits and assurance for this proposal will be provided by Appold, potentially including deliverable verification, control testing, spend validation, and milestone evidence assessment.

Intersect will use Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with specified TRSC and PSSC addresses, role-based authorization thresholds, external oversight entities, and a public dashboard for tracking funds.

summary: The document requests 1,193,000 ADA for 12 months of TSC support, gives a three-work-package budget, describes governance and smart-contract oversight mechanisms, and references external voting, audit, and dashboard materials, but the deterministic assessment identifies missing complete summary, budget, feasibility, risk, alternatives, and failure-mode analysis.
